lines.text: Jehu tells the people he will serve Baal a lot, and says anyone missing from the great sacrifice will not live.
All of Baal's servants fill the temple, Jehu has garments brought out for them, and he and Jehonadab enter.
Jehu stations fifty men outside, and after the burnt offering the guards and officers kill Baal's servants.
Jehu's men burn the sacred pillar and make the temple a latrine, and Jehu tears down the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

wrong_details.wrong: Jehu tears down the golden calves at Bethel and Dan
wrong_details.true: Jehu did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan

lines.text: The LORD promises Jehu four generations on the throne, and after twenty-eight years his son Jehoahaz reigns in his place.
